name: io.github.PlaylistExchange/playlistexchange
title: PlaylistExchange
description: Search user-curated playlists by keyword, genre, or moment, and read any playlist in full.

tools.name: search_playlists
tools.description: Search PlaylistExchange playlists by keyword, genre, or moment (running, sleep, driving, workout, party, focus). Returns matching playlists with their sound summary, plus matching guides when no playlist fits yet.

tools.name: get_playlist
tools.description: One playlist in full by slug: tracks, per-track genres and audio features, sound summary, curator, who shared it, and URL.

tools.name: list_genres
tools.description: Every genre any playlist carries, with how many playlists carry it.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Guides (what makes a playlist work for running, sleep, and more) and answer pages (best playlist for late night driving, working out, a party), each with its question, URL, and rubric or answer.

tools.name: post_playlist
tools.description: Post a public Spotify playlist as the signed-in user. Requires a Clerk OAuth token (see /auth.md). The playlist is credited to the token's user, who needs a username. 10 posts a day per account; a playlist already on the site is rejected.

tools.name: list_my_playlists
tools.description: The signed-in user's own playlists on PlaylistExchange, newest first. Requires a Clerk OAuth token (see /auth.md).
